statements: Add importUsers(store, rows, now) to src/users.mjs, for moving customers over from the old system. Each row is what addUser takes.

An import either happens completely or leaves everything exactly as it was. If it cannot happen, it throws HttpError 422 with code import_invalid, and the error has a row property holding the index of the first bad row.
It returns the number of users added.
The rules in the README hold for imported users like any others.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add the bulk user import, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
